questions.stem: 设函数 \( f(x, y) \) 连续，且 \( f(x, y) = f(y, x) = f(-x, y) \)，则 \( \int_{-2}^{2} dx \int_{\sqrt{4 - x^2}}^{2} f(x, y) \, \mathrm{d}y = \)

solution.analysis_md:
由题意知,此二重积分的积分区域为
\[
D = \{(x, y) | \sqrt {4 - x ^ {2}} \leqslant y \leqslant 2, - 2 \leqslant x \leqslant 2 \},
\]
对应图像如图所示.
![](/uploads/books/1303886cf4b7e8955b89446c26f3efdc8d62f71869e2f69dbbb20f636907a64a.jpg)
\[
\begin{array}{l} I = \int_ {- 2} ^ {2} \mathrm{d} x \int_ {\sqrt {4 - x ^ {2}}} ^ {2} f (x, y) \mathrm{d} y \\ = \int_ {0} ^ {2} \left[ \int_ {- 2} ^ {- \sqrt {4 - y ^ {2}}} f (x, y) \mathrm{d} x + \int_ {\sqrt {4 - y ^ {2}}} ^ {2} f (x, y) \mathrm{d} x \right] \mathrm{d} y. \\ \end{array}
\]
故选项A错误.
又 \( f(x,y)=f(-x,y) \) ，且积分区域关于y轴对称，则 \( I=2\int_{0}^{2}\left[\int_{\sqrt{4-y^{2}}}^{2}f(x,y)\mathrm{d}x\right]\mathrm{d}y \) 。故选项B错误。
记 \(D_{1} = \{(x,y)\mid (x,y)\in D,x > y\}\) .由 \(f(x,y) = f(y,x)\) ，得 \(I = 4\iint_{D_1}f(x,y)\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y.\)
用极坐标来表示， \( I=4\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{4}}\mathrm{d}\theta\int_{2}^{2\sec\theta}f(r\cos\theta,r\sin\theta)r\mathrm{d}r. \)  故选C.

questions.stem: 若级数 \(\sum_{n=1}^{\infty} (-1)^{n+1} \frac{\sqrt{n+1} - \sqrt{n}}{n^p}\) 条件收敛, 则 \(p\) 的取值范围为

solution.analysis_md:
令 \(a_{n} = \frac{\sqrt{n + 1} - \sqrt{n}}{n^{p}} > 0\)，则当 \(n \to \infty\) 时，
\[
a _ {n} = \frac {1}{(\sqrt {n + 1} + \sqrt {n}) n ^ {p}} = \frac {1}{\sqrt {n} \left(\sqrt {1 + \frac {1}{n}} + 1\right) n ^ {p}} \sim \frac {1}{2 n ^ {\frac {p + \frac {1}{2}}{2}}}.
\]
故当 \(p + \frac{1}{2} > 1\)，即 \(p > \frac{1}{2}\) 时，\(\sum_{n=1}^{\infty} a_n\) 收敛，则原级数绝对收敛；
当 \( p+\frac{1}{2}\leqslant1 \) ，即 \( p\leqslant\frac{1}{2} \) 时， \( \sum_{n=1}^{\infty}a_{n} \) 发散，则原级数非绝对收敛.
当 \(0 < p + \frac{1}{2} \leqslant 1\)，即 \(-\frac{1}{2} < p \leqslant \frac{1}{2}\) 时，显然 \(a_{n} \to 0 (n \to \infty)\). 令
\[
f (x) = x ^ {p} (\sqrt {x + 1} + \sqrt {x}) (x > 0),
\]
由于 \(f^{\prime}(x) = x^{p - 1}(\sqrt{x + 1} +\sqrt{x})\left(p + \frac{\sqrt{x}}{2\sqrt{x + 1}}\right),\)
参考答案与分析 卷(六)
[NO TEXT]
且 \(x^{p - 1} > 0,\sqrt{x + 1} +\sqrt{x} >0,\)
而 \(\lim_{x\to +\infty}\left(p + \frac{\sqrt{x}}{2\sqrt{x + 1}}\right) = p + \frac{1}{2} >0,\)
所以当 \(x\) 充分大时, \(f(x)\) 单调增加, 于是当 \(n\) 充分大时, \(a_{n} = \frac{1}{f(n)}\) 单调减少, 故由莱布尼茨判别法可知, 当 \(-\frac{1}{2} < p \leqslant \frac{1}{2}\) 时, 原级数条件收敛;
当 \( p+\frac{1}{2}\leqslant0 \) ，即 \( p\leqslant-\frac{1}{2} \) 时， \( a_{n} \) 不趋于 \( 0(n\to\infty) \) ，故当 \( p\leqslant-\frac{1}{2} \) 时，原级数发散。故选D.

questions.stem: 设函数 \( f(t) \) 连续, 令 \( F(x, y) = \int_{0}^{y - x} (y - x - t)f(t)dt \), 则

options.A: \(\frac{\partial F}{\partial x} = \frac{\partial F}{\partial y}, \frac{\partial^2 F}{\partial x^2} = \frac{\partial^2 F}{\partial y^2}\).
options.B: \(\frac{\partial F}{\partial x} = \frac{\partial F}{\partial y}, \frac{\partial^2 F}{\partial x^2} = -\frac{\partial^2 F}{\partial y^2}\)
options.C: \(\frac{\partial F}{\partial x} = -\frac{\partial F}{\partial y}, \frac{\partial^2 F}{\partial x^2} = \frac{\partial^2 F}{\partial y^2}\).
options.D: \(\frac{\partial F}{\partial x} = -\frac{\partial F}{\partial y}, \frac{\partial^2 F}{\partial x^2} = -\frac{\partial^2 F}{\partial y^2}\).

solution.analysis_md:
\(F(x,y) = y\int_{0}^{y - x}f(t)\mathrm{d}t - x\int_{0}^{y - x}f(t)\mathrm{d}t - \int_{0}^{y - x}tf(t)\mathrm{d}t,\)
则
\[
\frac {\partial F}{\partial x} = - y f (y - x) - \int_ {0} ^ {y - x} f (t) \mathrm{d} t + x f (y - x) + (y - x) f (y - x) = - \int_ {0} ^ {y - x} f (t) \mathrm{d} t,
\]
\[
\frac {\partial^ {2} F}{\partial x ^ {2}} = f (y - x),
\]
\[
\frac {\partial F}{\partial y} = \int_ {0} ^ {y - x} f (t) \mathrm{d} t + y f (y - x) - x f (y - x) - (y - x) f (y - x) = \int_ {0} ^ {y - x} f (t) \mathrm{d} t,
\]
\[
\frac {\partial^ {2} F}{\partial y ^ {2}} = f (y - x),
\]
可得
\[
\frac {\partial F}{\partial x} = - \frac {\partial F}{\partial y}, \frac {\partial^ {2} F}{\partial x ^ {2}} = \frac {\partial^ {2} F}{\partial y ^ {2}}.
\]
故选C.

questions.stem: 设 \(A, B\) 是 \(n\) 阶矩阵, \(A^{*}, B^{*}\) 分别是 \(A, B\) 对应的伴随矩阵, 则分块矩阵 \(C = \begin{pmatrix} O & A \\ B & O \end{pmatrix}\) 的伴随矩阵 \(C^{*} =\)

solution.analysis_md:
代入选项逐个验算即可,其中
\[
\begin{array}{l} \left( \begin{array}{c c} O & A \\ B & O \end{array} \right) \left( \begin{array}{c c} O & (- 1) ^ {n} | A | B ^ {*} \\ (- 1) ^ {n} | B | A ^ {*} & O \end{array} \right) \\ = \left( \begin{array}{c c} (- 1) ^ {n} | B | A A ^ {*} & O \\ O & (- 1) ^ {n} | A | B B ^ {*} \end{array} \right) \\ = (- 1) ^ {n} | A | | B | \left( \begin{array}{c c} E & O \\ O & E \end{array} \right) = | C | \left( \begin{array}{c c} E & O \\ O & E \end{array} \right) = C C ^ {*}. \\ \end{array}
\]
故选B.

questions.stem: 设矩阵 \(A = \begin{pmatrix} 1 & -1 & 1 \\ -2 & 2 & 1 \\ 1 & -1 & k \end{pmatrix}, r((3E - A)^2) < r(3E - A)\), 其中 \(E\) 是 3 阶单位矩阵, 则常数 \(k =\)

solution.analysis_md:
直接计算,得
\[
3 \boldsymbol {E} - \boldsymbol {A} = \left( \begin{array}{c c c} 2 & 1 & - 1 \\ 2 & 1 & - 1 \\ - 1 & 1 & 3 - k \end{array} \right),
\]
\[
(3 \boldsymbol {E} - \boldsymbol {A}) ^ {2} = \left( \begin{array}{c c c} 2 & 1 & - 1 \\ 2 & 1 & - 1 \\ - 1 & 1 & 3 - k \end{array} \right) \left( \begin{array}{c c c} 2 & 1 & - 1 \\ 2 & 1 & - 1 \\ - 1 & 1 & 3 - k \end{array} \right) = \left( \begin{array}{c c c} 7 & 2 & k - 6 \\ 7 & 2 & k - 6 \\ k - 3 & 3 - k & (3 - k) ^ {2} \end{array} \right).
\]
因为无论 k 取何值, 都有  \( r(3E-A)=2 \) , 所以当且仅当 k=3 时,  \( r((3E-A)^{2})=1 \) , 满足  \( r((3E-A)^{2})<r(3E-A) \) . 因此, k=3. 故选 A.

questions.stem: 设 \(n\) 阶方阵 \(A = (\alpha_{1}, \alpha_{2}, \cdots, \alpha_{n}), B = (\beta_{1}, \beta_{2}, \cdots, \beta_{n}), AB = (\gamma_{1}, \gamma_{2}, \cdots, \gamma_{n})\), 记向量组 \(I: \alpha_{1}, \alpha_{2}, \cdots, \alpha_{n}\), 向量组 \(II: \beta_{1}, \beta_{2}, \cdots, \beta_{n}\), 向量组 \(III: \gamma_{1}, \gamma_{2}, \cdots, \gamma_{n}\). 如果向量组 \(III\) 线性相关, 则

options.C: 向量组 \(I\) 与 \(II\) 都线性相关.
options.D: 向量组 \(I\) 与 \(II\) 至少有一个线性相关.

solution.analysis_md: 若向量组 I 与向量组 II 均线性无关, 则有 \(r(A) = r(B) = n\), 进而可知 \(r(AB) = n\), 即向量组 III 线性无关. 上述命题的逆否命题亦成立, 即向量组 III 线性相关时, 向量组 I 与 II 至少有一个线性相关.

questions.stem: 设随机变量 \((X_{1}, X_{2}) \sim N(0, 0; \sigma_{1}^{2}, \sigma_{2}^{2}; \rho), \sigma_{1} \neq \sigma_{2}\), 若 \(Y_{1} = X_{1} \cos \alpha + X_{2} \sin \alpha\) 与 \(Y_{2} = X_{2} \cos \alpha - X_{1} \sin \alpha\) 相互独立, \(\cos 2\alpha \neq 0\), 则 \(\tan 2\alpha =\)

solution.analysis_md:
\(\operatorname{Cov}(Y_1,Y_2) = \operatorname{Cov}(X_1\cos \alpha +X_2\sin \alpha ,X_1(-\sin \alpha) + X_2\cos \alpha)\)
\[
\begin{array}{l} = \cos \alpha \cdot (- \sin \alpha) \cdot D (X _ {1}) + (\cos^ {2} \alpha - \sin^ {2} \alpha) \operatorname{Cov} (X _ {1}, X _ {2}) + \cos \alpha \cdot \sin \alpha \cdot D (X _ {2}) \\ = \cos \alpha \cdot \sin \alpha \left(\sigma_ {2} ^ {2} - \sigma_ {1} ^ {2}\right) + \rho \sigma_ {1} \sigma_ {2} \left(\cos^ {2} \alpha - \sin^ {2} \alpha\right) \\ = \frac {1}{2} \left(\sigma_ {2} ^ {2} - \sigma_ {1} ^ {2}\right) \sin 2 \alpha + \rho \sigma_ {1} \sigma_ {2} \cos 2 \alpha \\ = \cos 2 \alpha \left[ \frac {1}{2} \left(\sigma_ {2} ^ {2} - \sigma_ {1} ^ {2}\right) \tan 2 \alpha + \rho \sigma_ {1} \sigma_ {2} \right] = 0. \\ \end{array}
\]
由 \(\cos 2\alpha \neq 0\) ，有 \(\frac{1}{2} (\sigma_2^2 -\sigma_1^2)\tan 2\alpha = -\rho \sigma_1\sigma_2\) ，即 \(\tan 2\alpha = 2\rho \frac{\sigma_1\sigma_2}{\sigma_1^2 - \sigma_2^2}\) ，选C.

\begin{array}{l} P \left\{\left| \overline {{{X}}} - \overline {{{Y}}} \right| > \sigma \right\} = P \left\{\frac {\sqrt {n} (\overline {{{X}}} - \overline {{{Y}}})}{\sqrt {2} \sigma} > \frac {\sqrt {n} \sigma}{\sqrt {2} \sigma} \right\} + P \left\{\frac {\sqrt {n} (\overline {{{X}}} - \overline {{{Y}}})}{\sqrt {2} \sigma} <   - \frac {\sqrt {n} \sigma}{\sqrt {2} \sigma} \right\} \\ = P \left\{\frac {\sqrt {n} (\overline {{{X}}} - \overline {{{Y}}})}{\sqrt {2} \sigma} > \sqrt {\frac {n}{2}} \right\} + P \left\{\frac {\sqrt {n} (\overline {{{X}}} - \overline {{{Y}}})}{\sqrt {2} \sigma} <   - \sqrt {\frac {n}{2}} \right\} \\ = 2 P \left\{\frac {\sqrt {n} (\overline {{{X}}} - \overline {{{Y}}})}{\sqrt {2} \sigma} > \sqrt {\frac {n}{2}} \right\} \leqslant 0. 0 5, \\ \end{array}

二、填空题

questions.stem: 设 \(x \to 0\) 时, \(\ln \frac{2 + x}{2 + \sin x}\) 与 \(x^n\) 为同阶无穷小, 则 \(n =\) ____.

solution.analysis_md:
当 \(x \to 0\) 时，
\[
\ln \frac {2 + x}{2 + \sin x} = \ln \frac {2 + \sin x - \sin x + x}{2 + \sin x} \sim \frac {- \sin x + x}{2 + \sin x} \sim \frac {1}{2} \left(\frac {1}{6} x ^ {3}\right) = \frac {1}{1 2} x ^ {3}.
\]
故与 \( x^{3} \) 同阶，n=3。

questions.stem: 设 \( y \geqslant -2 \)，则微分方程 \( x' - \sqrt{x + y^2} = -2y \) 满足 \( x(0) = 1 \) 的特解为 ____.

solution.analysis_md: 由题意知 \(x' + 2y = \sqrt{x + y^2}\)，令 \(x + y^2 = u\)，则 \(\frac{\mathrm{d}u}{\mathrm{d}y} = \sqrt{u}\)，即 \(\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{u}} \mathrm{d}u = \int \mathrm{d}y\)，有 \(2\sqrt{u} = y + C\)，即 \(2\sqrt{x + y^2} = y + C\)，又 \(x(0) = 1\)，于是 \(C = 2\)，得 \(\sqrt{x + y^2} = \frac{y}{2} + 1\)，整理得 \(x = -\frac{3}{4} y^2 + y + 1 (y \geqslant -2)\).

由轮换对称性,有
\[
\oint_ {\Gamma} x ^ {2} \mathrm{d} s = \oint_ {\Gamma} y ^ {2} \mathrm{d} s = \oint_ {\Gamma} z ^ {2} \mathrm{d} s, \oint_ {\Gamma} x \mathrm{d} s = \oint_ {\Gamma} y \mathrm{d} s = \oint_ {\Gamma} z \mathrm{d} s.
\]
故 \(\oint_{\Gamma}(y^2 + 2x - z)\mathrm{d}s = \frac{1}{3}\oint_{\Gamma}(x^2 + y^2 + z^2)\mathrm{d}s + \frac{1}{3}\oint_{\Gamma}(x + y + z)\mathrm{d}s = \frac{2}{3} l_r.\)
如图所示, 设球心到平面 \(x + y + z = 1\) 的距离为 \(d\), 曲线 \(\Gamma\) 围成的圆的半径为 \(r\), 则
\[
d = \frac {\left| 0 + 0 + 0 - 1 \right|}{\sqrt {1 ^ {2} + 1 ^ {2} + 1 ^ {2}}} = \frac {1}{\sqrt {3}},
\]
故
\[
r = \sqrt {1 - \frac {1}{3}} = \sqrt {\frac {2}{3}},
\]
于是
\[
l _ {r} = 2 \pi \sqrt {\frac {2}{3}},
\]
故
原式 \(= \frac{2}{3} l_{r} = \frac{2}{3}\cdot 2\pi \sqrt{\frac{2}{3}} = \frac{4\sqrt{6}}{9}\pi .\)

questions.stem:
设 \(\Sigma\) 为上半球体 \(0 \leqslant z \leqslant \sqrt{a^2 - x^2 - y^2} (a > 0)\) 的表面外侧, 则曲面积分
\[
\iint_ {\Sigma} x z ^ {2} \mathrm{d} y \mathrm{d} z + (x ^ {2} y - z ^ {3}) \mathrm{d} z \mathrm{d} x + (2 x y + y ^ {2} z) \mathrm{d} x \mathrm{d} y = \underline {{{\quad}}}.
\]

solution.analysis_md:
由高斯公式,得
\[
\begin{array}{l} \oiint_ {\Sigma} x z ^ {2} \mathrm{d} y \mathrm{d} z + (x ^ {2} y - z ^ {3}) \mathrm{d} z \mathrm{d} x + (2 x y + y ^ {2} z) \mathrm{d} x \mathrm{d} y = \iiint_ {\Omega} (z ^ {2} + x ^ {2} + y ^ {2}) \mathrm{d} v \\ = \int_ {0} ^ {2 \pi} \mathrm{d} \theta \int_ {0} ^ {\frac {\pi}{2}} \mathrm{d} \varphi \int_ {0} ^ {a} r ^ {2} \cdot r ^ {2} \sin \varphi \mathrm{d} r = \frac {2}{5} \pi a ^ {5}, \\ \end{array}
\]
参考答案与分析 卷(六)

其中  \( \Omega=\{(x,y,z)\mid0\leqslant z\leqslant\sqrt{a^{2}-x^{2}-y^{2}}\} \) .

questions.stem: 设总体 \(X\) 的概率密度为 \(f(x) = \begin{cases} \frac{\beta x}{\alpha^2}, & 0 \leqslant x \leqslant \alpha, \\ 0, & \text{其他}, \end{cases}\) 其中 \(\alpha (\alpha > 1)\) 是未知参数, \(X_1, X_2, \cdots, X_n\) 是来自总体 \(X\) 的简单随机样本, 记 \(p = P\{0 < X < \sqrt{\alpha}\}, X_{(1)} = \min \{X_1, X_2, \cdots, X_n\}, X_{(n)} = \max \{X_1, X_2, \cdots, X_n\}\), 则 \(p\) 的最大似然估计量 \(\hat{p}\) 为 ____.

solution.analysis_md:
由归一性, 得  \( \int_{-\infty}^{+\infty} f(x) \, dx = \int_{0}^{a} \frac{\beta x}{\alpha^{2}} \, dx = \frac{\beta}{2} = 1, \beta = 2 \) .
\[
p = P \left\{0 <   X <   \sqrt {\alpha} \right\} = \int_ {0} ^ {\sqrt {\alpha}} f (x) \mathrm{d} x = \frac {1}{\alpha}.
\]
设  \( x_{1}, x_{2}, \cdots, x_{n} \)  为来自  \( X_{1}, X_{2}, \cdots, X_{n} \)  的一组观测值，当  \( 0 \leqslant x_{1} \leqslant \alpha, 0 \leqslant x_{2} \leqslant \alpha, \cdots, 0 \leqslant x_{n} \leqslant \alpha \)  时，似然函数为
\[
L (\alpha) = f (x _ {1}) f (x _ {2}) \dots f (x _ {n}) = \frac {2 ^ {n}}{\alpha^ {2 n}} x _ {1} x _ {2} \dots x _ {n}.
\]
显然  \( L(\alpha) \)  关于  \( \alpha \)  单调减少，且  \( \alpha \geqslant \max\left\{x_{1}, x_{2}, \cdots, x_{n}\right\} \) ，则  \( \alpha \)  的最大似然估计量为
\[
\hat {\alpha} = \max \left\{X _ {1}, X _ {2}, \dots , X _ {n} \right\}.
\]
又知 \(p = \frac{1}{\alpha}\) 是关于 \(\alpha\) 的单调函数, 根据最大似然估计量的不变性, 可知 \(p\) 的最大似然估计量为
\[
\hat {p} = \frac {1}{\alpha} = \frac {1}{\max \left\{X _ {1} , X _ {2} , \cdots , X _ {n} \right\}} = \frac {1}{X _ {(n)}}.
\]
三、解答题

questions.stem:
设 \( f(x)=1-x^{2}(0\leqslant x\leqslant\pi),S(x)=\frac{a_{0}}{2}+\sum_{n=1}^{\infty}a_{n}\cos nx,x\in R, \) 其中
\[
a _ {n} = \frac {2}{\pi} \int_ {0} ^ {\pi} f (x) \cos n x \mathrm{d} x, \text {计算} S (- \pi) + \sum_ {n = 1} ^ {\infty} \frac {(- 1) ^ {n + 1}}{n ^ {2}}
\]

solution.analysis_md:

\[

\]
\[
\begin{array}{l} a _ {n} = \frac {2}{\pi} \int_ {0} ^ {\pi} f (x) \cos n x \mathrm{d} x = \frac {2}{\pi} \left(\int_ {0} ^ {\pi} \cos n x \mathrm{d} x - \int_ {0} ^ {\pi} x ^ {2} \cos n x \mathrm{d} x\right) \\ = \frac {2}{\pi} \left(0 - \int_ {0} ^ {\pi} x ^ {2} \cos n x \mathrm{d} x\right) = - \frac {2}{\pi} \left(\frac {x ^ {2} \sin n x}{n} \Bigg | _ {0} ^ {\pi} - \int_ {0} ^ {\pi} \frac {2 x \sin n x}{n} \mathrm{d} x\right) \\ = \frac {2}{\pi} \frac {2 \pi \cdot (- 1) ^ {n + 1}}{n ^ {2}} = \frac {4 \cdot (- 1) ^ {n + 1}}{n ^ {2}}, n = 1, 2, \dots , \\ \end{array}
\]
故 \(S(x) = \frac{a_0}{2} + \sum_{n=1}^{\infty} a_n \cos nx\) 为函数 \(f(x)\) 以 \(2\pi\) 为周期的傅里叶级数的和函数, 根据狄利克雷收敛定理, 有
\[
S (- \pi) = \frac {f (- \pi + 0) + f (\pi - 0)}{2} = \frac {1 - \pi^ {2} + 1 - \pi^ {2}}{2} = 1 - \pi^ {2}.
\]
取 \(x = 0\) ， \(S(0) = f(0)\) ，得
\[
1 = 1 - \frac {\pi^ {2}}{3} + \sum_ {n = 1} ^ {\infty} \frac {4 \bullet (- 1) ^ {n + 1}}{n ^ {2}},
\]
于是 \(\sum_{n=1}^{\infty} \frac{(-1)^{n+1}}{n^2} = \frac{\pi^2}{12}\),
故 \(S(-\pi) + \sum_{n=1}^{\infty} \frac{(-1)^{n+1}}{n^2} = 1 - \pi^2 + \frac{\pi^2}{12} = 1 - \frac{11}{12}\pi^2.\)

questions.stem: 设函数 \( f(x) \) 在 \( (a, b) \) 上二次可微，证明：对任意 \( x \in (a, b) \) 及适当小的正数 \( h \) (使 \( x + h, x - h \in (a, b) \))，不等式 \( f(x) \leqslant \frac{1}{2} [f(x + h) + f(x - h)] \) 成立的充要条件是 \( f''(x) \geqslant 0, x \in (a, b) \).

solution.analysis_md:
必要性.若对任意 \( x\in(a,b) \) 及适当小的h>0,有
\[
f (x) \leqslant \frac {1}{2} [ f (x + h) + f (x - h) ],
\]
则对上述 \(x\) 及 \(h\) 有
\[
\frac {f (x + h) + f (x - h) - 2 f (x)}{h ^ {2}} \geqslant 0.
\]
两边取极限, 由于 \( f(x) \) 二次可微, 左端极限为
\[
\begin{array}{l} \lim _ {h \rightarrow 0} \frac {f (x + h) + f (x - h) - 2 f (x)}{h ^ {2}} = \lim _ {h \rightarrow 0} \frac {f ^ {\prime} (x + h) - f ^ {\prime} (x - h)}{2 h} \\ = \lim _ {h \rightarrow 0} \frac {1}{2} \left[ \frac {f ^ {\prime} (x + h) - f ^ {\prime} (x)}{h} + \frac {f ^ {\prime} (x - h) - f ^ {\prime} (x)}{- h} \right] = f ^ {\prime \prime} (x). \\ \end{array}
\]
因此得 \( f''(x) \geqslant 0, x \in (a, b) \).
充分性. 若 \( f''(x) \geqslant 0, x \in (a, b) \)，则 \( f'(x) \) 单调不减，于是对任意的 \( x \in (a, b) \) 及适当小的 \( h > 0 \)，有
\[
\begin{array}{l} f (x + h) + f (x - h) - 2 f (x) \\ = \int_ {x} ^ {x + h} [ f ^ {\prime} (t) - f ^ {\prime} (t - h) ] \mathrm{d} t \geqslant 0, \\ \end{array}
\]
即 \( f(x)\leqslant\frac{1}{2}[f(x+h)+f(x-h)] \) .
